pitches.logline: Toyota leads Le Mans 2016 with three minutes to go and wants the win, but a mechanical problem stops the car, and the slow last lap costs it even its classification.
pitches.hook: Frame 0: the No. 5 Toyota at three minutes to go, the clock running; the engine sputters on the line.

pitches.logline: Toyota led the 2016 race into its last three minutes, yet the result sheet has no Toyota at all; the film rewinds to show why.
pitches.hook: Frame 0: a split-flap result board flips names in, the Toyota slot stays blank and slams shut with a thud.

pitches.logline: Kazuki Nakajima loses Le Mans 2016 three minutes from the end, and the car is not even classified, yet two years later he is in the winning Toyota.
pitches.hook: Frame 0: Nakajima's Toyota on the photo, three minutes to go, the engine note breaks with a misfire.

treatment.logline: Toyota leads Le Mans 2016 with three minutes to go and wants the win, but a mechanical problem stops the car, and the slow last lap costs it even its classification.
treatment.hero: The leading No. 5 Toyota with Kazuki Nakajima, Toyota's driver, at the helm
treatment.obstacle: A mechanical problem in the last three minutes, and the six-minute limit on the last lap

hook.event: The No. 5 Toyota's dash at three minutes to go, P1 and the clock running, the engine sputters and the shift lights twitch

act1: Toyota leads Le Mans 2016, Nakajima at the helm, every shift light lit, the track streaming
A mechanical problem: the lights die, the warning lamp blinks, the track slows
The car stops, Porsche goes by and wins: P1 struck out
treatment.turn: A 0.6 s hold after the stop, then the hourglass: the last lap had six minutes and the sand runs out first

reveal.what: Twist card on the No. 5 photo: Toyota not even in the results, one punch word

treatment.payoff: 2018: Toyota wins Le Mans with Nakajima in the crew; the same cockpit's lights sweep back on to P1 and the chequered flag waves
treatment.signature: The prototype's cockpit from the seat: the shift lights die one by one, the lamp turns red, the track stops and P1 goes out; then a six-minute hourglass empties before the lap bar reaches the flag
